mistakes.description: CAT CLI launcher was invoked repeatedly without required CAT environment variables because the invoking skill did not show the full runtime environment preamble.
mistakes.root_cause: CAT skill instructions for direct client/bin launcher calls under-specified required runtime-neutral environment setup, so the agent used trial-and-error retries (adding CAT_SESSION_ID, then CAT_PROJECT_DIR, then CAT_PLUGIN_DATA) instead of loading the complete Codex CAT environment block first.
mistakes.correct_behavior: Before invoking any CAT launcher under client/bin, initialize CAT_PLUGIN_ROOT, CAT_PLUGIN_DATA, CAT_CONFIG_DIR, CAT_PROJECT_DIR, CAT_RUNTIME, and CAT_SESSION_ID in the same command invocation or abort.
